projects.title: Embedded Pac-Man on Spartan-7
projects.description: Hardware/software co-design using MicroBlaze soft processor and custom RTL video rendering pipeline for real-time arcade emulation.

note.message: Unforunately, the RTL & MicroBlaze source files were corrupted and lost during project demo. Currently rebuilding with an updated hardware pipeline.

projects.title: Custom Robotics Interface Board
projects.description: STM32G474-based custom PCB integrating sensor interfaces, motor drivers, CAN/RS-485 communication, and power regulation.

projects.title: Advanced Custom Keyboard Platform
projects.description: Hall-effect sensing with analog multiplexing and multi-MCU architecture for ultra-low latency input detection and rapid trigger customization.

projects.title: VEX Robotics Autonomous Navigation
projects.description: Designed and implemented autonomous navigation systems for competition robots using odometry, PID control, Pure Pursuit path following, spline generation, and particle filter localization.

projects.title: Real-Time Robotics Simulation
projects.description: Built a discrete-time simulator for robot dynamics, actuator constraints, and sensor noise. Used for algorithm development and testing before deploying to hardware.

projects.title: Power Electronics & Battery Management
projects.description: Explored buck/boost converters, LiPo battery monitoring, coulomb counting, and thermal management circuits. Implemented BMS firmware with cell balancing logic.

projects.title: STM32 HAL and Bare-Metal Exploration
projects.description: Deep-dived into ARM Cortex-M interrupt handling, DMA configuration, peripheral clocking, memory protection, and linker scripts. Built from bare registers up to working HAL implementations.
